verdicts.question: Is the cable routing in the site photos continuous and consistent across the documented run — from rooftop panels to DCDB to inverter to ACDB to solar meter to main panel — with no orphan ends, no unexplained mid-run size changes, and visible conduit / cable-tie / clipping where the run is exposed?
verdicts.designer_notes: No designer answer for this target — the vision routine verifies it by tracing cables across photos with 'Cable Routing', 'Equipment Location', 'Meter Box' and similar captions on pages 4+.
verdicts.photo_observation: This is a microinverter (Enphase IQ8P) system, so there is no separate DCDB/central inverter/ACDB stage — the traceable run is roof-mounted panels -> AC cable -> Enphase accessories -> solar meter -> main meter. Tracing the color-coded overlays against the legend on page 4: the purple AC-cable line starts near the 'PV modules' label on the roof (page 11), continues through a PVC-sheet opening (page 12), runs along interior wall/ceiling corners (pages 13-14) and arrives labeled at the 'Main meter'/'Solar meter' area (page 15). Separately, the green (AC earthing) + orange (LA cable) lines start at the roof parapet near the same PV area (page 16), pass through the same PVC hole (page 17), run along interior walls (pages 17-18) to the 'Enphase accessories' location, and finally reach the AC/DC/LA earth pit markers (page 19). Each segment's arrow endpoint lines up with the start of the next photo's line, so no orphan ends are apparent. However, one exposed run on the roof floor just past the PVC opening (page 12, top photo) shows a bare wire lying loose on the ground with no visible conduit, clip, or cable tie.
verdicts.rationale: The overall routing trace is continuous end-to-end across the annotated photos with no orphan ends, but one short exposed segment on the roof lacks visible conduit/clipping, so this needs a human check rather than an automatic PASS.
